intro: Kamarhati lies on the east bank of the Hooghly, just north of Kolkata, in a belt of old jute mills, mill colonies and crowded neighbourhoods. Schools, municipal parks and housing complexes here ask us for playground equipment that can take daily use in a humid climate. FunPlay Systems makes it at our factory in Vasai, about 1,650 km away, and sends it to West Bengal by road.

A town built on jute knows rope better than most, and rope is one of the most popular parts of a modern playground. Climbing nets, rope bridges and hanging rings let children climb, balance and swing in ways a slide cannot offer. Our play rope is made for outdoor use and carries a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Like any rope, it lasts longer when it is checked and cared for, especially through a long Bengal monsoon.

sections.h: Looking after rope nets and climbers
sections.html:
Run a hand along the main ropes every month and look for fraying, cuts or flattened strands. Check that knots and connectors are tight and that the net has not slipped on its frame. Rope dries slowly in humid air, so place climbing nets where they get sun and a breeze. Never let children tie extra ropes or cloth onto the equipment. If a rope is damaged, close that piece and call our after-sales team for a replacement.

See our Straight Net and other climbers, or playground equipment in Baranagar.

faq.q: How long does play rope last outdoors?
faq.a: Our play rope is made for outdoor use and carries a 3-year warranty against manufacturing defects. Regular checks for fraying and loose knots, and a sunny, airy spot, help it last.

faq.q: What should we do if a climbing net is damaged?
faq.a: Close that piece to children straight away and contact our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921 with photos. We will advise on repair or a replacement net.

faq.q: Do you supply Kamarhati and the north Kolkata area?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver from our Vasai factory to Kamarhati and nearby towns along the Hooghly by road, and install with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

intro: Kanpur is one of the largest industrial cities in Uttar Pradesh, known for leather, textiles and its institutes of higher education, with old schools, new housing societies and large public parks. Buyers here have many options, so we are often asked how our own ranges differ. FunPlay Systems designs and makes all of them at our factory in Vasai, about 1,100 km away, and sends orders to Kanpur by road.

We sell three families of play equipment. CoreCraft is our core range of multi play systems, themed stations, individual pieces, outdoor gym equipment and garden decor. Funplay Originals are structures designed by our own team, many inspired by Indian games and nature. The NexLev series covers our newer, larger play towers and wooden structures. Knowing which family to start with saves time when you share your site details.

sections.html:
For a school or housing society on a fixed budget, CoreCraft is the usual starting point, since you can mix individual swings, slides and see-saws with one multi play system. If you want a play area with a clear identity, such as a school drawn to the idea of Indian games, look at Funplay Originals. For a large park or a premium project that wants a striking centrepiece, the NexLev towers are worth a look. Whichever range you choose, we talk through materials for Kanpur's hot summers and cold winters.

Browse CoreCraft, Funplay Originals and the NexLev series, or see playground equipment in Lucknow.

faq.q: What is the difference between CoreCraft, Funplay Originals and NexLev?
faq.a: CoreCraft is our core range of play systems, individual pieces, outdoor gym and garden decor. Funplay Originals are designs by our own team, and NexLev covers newer, larger towers and wooden structures.

faq.q: Can we mix products from different ranges?
faq.a: Yes. Many layouts combine a centrepiece from one range with individual pieces from CoreCraft. We plan them together on one layout drawing with the safe play area marked.

faq.q: Do you supply housing societies in Kanpur?
faq.a: Yes. Societies, schools and parks across Kanpur can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install with our own team or a dealer in North India.

intro: Karaikudi is the main town of Chettinad, known for its grand old mansions, Athangudi tiles and the heritage hotels that now occupy some of those houses. Schools and new housing in the town also ask us for play areas. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 1,210 km away, and sends it to Tamil Nadu by road.

A heritage property needs a gentle approach. Old floors and courtyards should not be dug up or drilled, and a brightly coloured play tower can look out of place against carved wood and tiled verandahs. We usually suggest placing the play area in a side garden or rear courtyard, away from the main view, and using self-standing installation on any paved surface. Elsewhere in the state, we have installed a resort playground in Dindigul.

sections.h: A play area for a heritage hotel
sections.html:
Choose a spot that guests reach easily but that does not sit in front of the main facade. On an old paved or tiled courtyard, self-standing equipment rests on its own base, so nothing is drilled into the original floor. Pick a few soft colours from our roto-moulded shades, such as greens or earth tones, in place of every bright colour at once. Karaikudi is hot for most of the year, so put the play area under trees or a pergola and keep seating for parents nearby.

Read about our resort playground in Dindigul, or see playground equipment in Madurai.

faq.q: Can playground equipment be installed without drilling into an old floor?
faq.a: Yes. Self-standing installation lets the equipment rest on its own base, which suits paved or tiled courtyards. We check the surface from your photos before suggesting it.

faq.q: Have you worked in Tamil Nadu?
faq.a: Yes. We installed a resort playground in Dindigul. For Karaikudi we follow the same process: site photos, a layout drawing with the safe play area marked, then manufacture and installation.

faq.q: Can schools in Karaikudi order from you?
faq.a: Yes. Schools, housing projects and hotels can all order directly. We deliver from Vasai by road and install through our own team or a dealer in Tamil Nadu.

intro: Karawal Nagar is a densely built part of north-east Delhi, close to the Yamuna and the Uttar Pradesh border. Open space is scarce, so the few parks and school grounds in the area carry a lot of children every evening. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment for these sites at our factory in Vasai, about 1,130 km away, and sends it to Delhi by road.

In a small, busy park, the question to ask of each piece is how many children it can hold at once. A single swing serves one child at a time, while a four-seat see-saw or a four-seater merry-go-round keeps a whole group busy. We help residents' welfare associations and schools choose equipment by that measure, so queues stay short and quarrels fewer. Delhi's hot summers and smoggy winters also call for materials that are easy to wash clean.

sections.h: Choosing equipment for a crowded neighbourhood park
sections.html:
Look for pieces that several children use together: a multi-seat see-saw, a merry-go-round with fixed seats, a double swing or a play station with more than one slide. Avoid many single-child pieces scattered around, which use up ground and create queues. Keep the busiest pieces near the centre of the park, where adults can see them from the benches. Lay rubber flooring under every piece, since bare ground in a crowded park soon wears into dust or mud.

See our Jumbo Four Seater Merry-Go-Round and Double See Saw, or playground equipment in Loni.

faq.q: Which playground equipment holds the most children in a small park?
faq.a: Multi-seat see-saws, merry-go-rounds and play stations with more than one slide. They keep a group of children busy on a modest footprint, which a row of single swings cannot do.

faq.q: Can a residents' welfare association order directly?
faq.a: Yes. Share the park's measurements, photos and the age group of the children. We send a layout drawing and quote that your association can approve before we start manufacturing.

faq.q: Do you deliver to north-east Delhi?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from Vasai to Karawal Nagar and the rest of Delhi by road, and install it through our own team or a dealer in North India.

intro: Karimnagar, in northern Telangana on the Manair river, is known for its granite quarries and its silver filigree work. Granite is everywhere in the town, including the paving of many school courtyards, society gardens and parks. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for these sites from our factory in Vasai, about 660 km away, delivered by road.

Stone paving looks neat and needs little upkeep, but it is one of the hardest surfaces a child can fall on. Some older play areas in the region have swings and slides set straight onto granite or tiles. If yours is one of them, the paving may not need to come up at all. Rubber flooring can often be laid over a sound, level paved surface, with the equipment self-standing on its base or fixed in the way the site needs.

sections.h: Adding rubber flooring over stone or tiles
sections.html:
Check first that the paving is level and firmly bedded, since loose or broken slabs will show through the flooring. Mark the safe play area of each piece and cover that whole zone, not only the spot directly under a slide. Finish the edges neatly so there is no lip for children to trip on where flooring meets stone. Keep a slope for rainwater so it does not pool under the mats in the monsoon. Telangana's summer sun is strong, so plan shade over dark flooring.

See our In-Curve Post Swing, or playground equipment in Warangal.

faq.q: Is granite paving safe under playground equipment?
faq.a: Granite is very hard and gives no cushioning in a fall. We suggest rubber flooring over the safe play area of each piece, laid on the existing paving if it is sound and level.

faq.q: Can rubber flooring be laid over existing tiles?
faq.a: Usually, yes, if the tiles are firm and level. Loose or broken tiles should be fixed first, and the edges need a neat finish so children do not trip where flooring meets stone.

faq.q: Do you supply Karimnagar?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory to Karimnagar by road and can supply rubber flooring with the same order. Our installation team or a dealer in Telangana installs everything.

intro: Karnal is a prosperous agricultural city on the Grand Trunk Road in Haryana, known for its dairy and farm research institutes. Along with schools and colonies, we hear from families here who want a few pieces of play equipment for their own home garden or farmhouse. FunPlay Systems makes equipment for both at our factory in Vasai, about 1,220 km away, and sends it to Haryana by road.

A home playground is small, but the same rules apply as on a school ground. Each piece needs its safe play area, a cushioned surface and a firm foundation. Home buyers usually want a handful of pieces chosen for their own children's ages, with room to add more as the family grows. We can suggest a set that fits your lawn and send a simple layout before you order.

sections.h: Planning play equipment for a home garden or farmhouse
sections.html:
Choose pieces for the ages of your children now and in two or three years. A toddler swing and a spring rider suit little ones, while a 5 ft slide, a climber and a standard swing suit children from about six. Place the play area where it can be seen from the house or verandah, and away from the driveway and any water tank. Haryana's winters are cold and its summers very hot, so give the corner some shade and check the bolts at each change of season.

See our Dino Rider and S Slide, or playground equipment in Panipat.

faq.q: Can families buy playground equipment for a home garden?
faq.a: Yes. Families can order individual pieces for a home garden or farmhouse. Share the lawn size and your children's ages, and we will suggest a small set and a simple layout.

faq.q: Do home playgrounds need rubber flooring?
faq.a: Yes, under the safe play area of each piece. A lawn wears thin under swings and at slide exits, and rubber flooring gives a cushioned surface that stays even through the seasons.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Karnal?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory to Karnal and nearby towns in Haryana by road, and install it with our own team or a dealer in North India.

intro: Katihar is a railway junction town in north-east Bihar, in the low country between the Ganga and the rivers that come down from Nepal. Floods are part of life in this region, and school grounds and colony parks can stay under water for days. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for these sites from our factory in Vasai, about 1,650 km away, and sends it by road.

Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts come through standing water well, but a flood leaves behind silt, debris and loosened ground. The equipment should be checked before children use it again, however sound it looks. Our after-sales team can guide your staff through that check. If something has been damaged, send us photos and we will advise on repair or replacement parts. When planning a new play area here, also raise its base above the usual flood level where the site allows.

sections.h: Checking a playground after floodwater recedes
sections.html:
1. Keep children out until the ground is dry and the equipment has been inspected.
  2. Clear silt and debris from the flooring, decks and slide beds, and wash every surface with clean water.
  3. Check each foundation for erosion, and push firmly on every post to test for movement.
  4. Inspect springs, bearings and swing hangers, which suffer most from silt.

Record any damage with photos and send them to our after-sales team on +91 738 530 0921, so the right parts can be identified quickly. For nearby towns, see playground equipment in Purnia or Bhagalpur.

faq.q: Is playground equipment safe to use after a flood?
faq.a: Only after it has been cleaned and checked. Floodwater leaves silt in moving parts and can loosen foundations, so inspect every piece before reopening the play area.

faq.q: Does floodwater damage galvanised and roto-moulded equipment?
faq.a: These materials do not rust or rot in water, but silt wears bearings and springs, and soft ground can tilt posts. A full check after the water drains catches these problems early.

faq.q: Do you supply Katihar and north-east Bihar?
faq.a: Yes. We deliver from Vasai to Katihar and nearby districts by road, and install through our own team or a dealer in eastern India. Let us know if your site floods, and we will plan the base with that in mind.

intro: Katni, in the Mahakoshal region of Madhya Pradesh, is a railway junction known for its limestone and cement industry, and is often called the lime city. Colony parks, factory townships and schools here ask us for play areas, and many want something for adults too. FunPlay Systems makes both playground and outdoor gym equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 920 km away, and sends it by road.

A park where parents can exercise while their children play tends to be used more often than one built for children alone. Our Fun Fitness range includes outdoor gym machines such as walkers, twisters and leg presses, which can sit beside the play area. We plan both on one layout drawing, with separate zones and a clear path between them. Katni's summers are hot and its monsoon steady, so we plan shade and drainage for both zones.

sections.h: Combining a play area and an outdoor gym
sections.html:
Keep the gym zone close enough for parents to watch the play area, but separate it with a path or a low hedge so small children do not wander into moving machines. Put the toddler equipment on the side nearest the gym, since that is where parents will be. Choose simple machines that adults of any age can use, such as a walker or a seated twister. Add benches between the two zones for grandparents who prefer to sit and watch.

See our Fun Fitness range and our outdoor gym equipment in Katni, or playground equipment in Satna.

faq.q: Can you supply a playground and an outdoor gym for the same park?
faq.a: Yes. We make both and plan them on one layout drawing, with separate zones, a clear path between them and seating where parents can watch their children.

faq.q: Should children use outdoor gym machines?
faq.a: Outdoor gym machines are designed for adults, and children should play on their own equipment. Separating the two zones with a path or hedge helps keep small children away from moving parts.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Katni?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from Vasai to Katni by road, and our installation team or a dealer in Madhya Pradesh installs it according to your approved layout.

intro: Kavali is a coastal town in the Nellore district of Andhra Pradesh, a short distance from the Bay of Bengal, with a hot, humid climate and rain from the northeast monsoon. Schools, colleges and residential layouts here ask us for playground equipment. FunPlay Systems makes it at our factory in Vasai, about 900 km away, and delivers it to Kavali by road.

The slide is usually the first piece a school asks for, and its height matters more than its colour or shape. We make individual slides in three heights, three feet, five feet and seven feet, and each suits a different stage of childhood. Choosing the right one keeps young children safe and older ones interested. Tell us the classes that will use the play area, and we will suggest the right mix of heights for your ground.

sections.html:
As a rough guide, three-foot slides suit nursery and kindergarten children, who need a short ladder and a gentle run-out. Five-foot slides suit most primary classes, and seven-foot slides are for older children who climb ladders confidently. Each taller slide needs a longer clear run at the bottom, so check the safe play area before you choose. Tunnel and spiral versions add interest without extra height. In Kavali's coastal humidity, roto-moulded slide beds hold up better than painted metal.

See our three-foot, five-foot and seven-foot slides, or playground equipment in Nellore.

faq.q: Which slide height suits nursery children?
faq.a: The lowest slides in our range, at three feet, suit nursery and kindergarten children. They have a short ladder and a gentle run-out, and they fit a small play area.

faq.q: Do taller slides need more space?
faq.a: Yes. A taller slide needs a longer clear zone at the bottom, where children land and step away. We mark this safe play area on the layout drawing for every slide.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Kavali?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory to Kavali and nearby coastal towns by road, and install it with our own team or a dealer in Andhra Pradesh.

intro: Khammam is a district town in eastern Telangana, near the Andhra Pradesh border, with granite quarries and farmland around it. Schools, colleges and housing layouts here ask us for play areas that get children playing together. FunPlay Systems makes playground equipment at our factory in Vasai, about 800 km away, and delivers it to Khammam by road.

Some equipment is played on alone, and some only works with friends. A see-saw needs a partner, a merry-go-round needs someone to push, and a big structure with many routes turns into a game of chase. For schools that want children to mix across classes and friendships, we suggest putting more of the budget into these group pieces. Our Funplay Originals are designed with this kind of play in mind, and many take their ideas from games Indian children play together.

sections.h: Equipment that gets children playing together
sections.html:
Group play pieces need more space around them, since children move in and out from several sides. Place them in the centre of the play area with the safe play area clearly marked. Our Nature Sparsh structures are built for several children at once, and the Khel Khud range draws on games played in groups. A see-saw and a merry-go-round complete the set. Khammam's summers are very hot, so shade the central pieces first and keep single swings at the edges.

See our Nature Sparsh and Khel Khud ranges, or playground equipment in Suryapet.

faq.q: Which playground equipment encourages group play?
faq.a: See-saws, merry-go-rounds and larger structures with several routes, such as our Nature Sparsh and Khel Khud designs. They need more than one child to play, so children mix naturally.

faq.q: Do group play pieces need more space?
faq.a: Usually, since children approach them from several sides. We mark a clear safe play area around each one on the layout drawing so other equipment does not crowd it.

faq.q: Do you supply schools in Khammam?
faq.a: Yes. Schools, colleges and housing layouts in Khammam can order from us. We deliver from Vasai by road and install through our own team or a dealer in Telangana.

intro: Khandwa is the main town of the Nimar region in western Madhya Pradesh, with Omkareshwar on the Narmada a short drive away. Nimar summers are very hot, and for much of the year children here play outdoors mostly after the sun goes down. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for schools, colonies and municipal gardens from our factory in Vasai, about 450 km away, delivered by road.

A play area used mainly in the evening has to be planned for that. Light, sightlines and seating matter more than they would on a school ground used in the morning. We look at where existing street lights and building lights fall on your site and place the equipment within their reach. Swings and spinning pieces should never sit in a dark corner, where a child running past might not see them moving.

sections.h: Planning a play area for evening use
sections.html:
Put the play area where existing lights already reach, or plan new lighting with your electrician before the layout is fixed. Keep benches facing the equipment and inside the lit area, so parents can see every child. Avoid placing a swing set or merry-go-round at the dim edge of the park. Light-coloured equipment from our roto-moulded shades is easier to see at dusk than dark tones. Roto-moulded slides and decks also cool down soon after sunset.

See our Giraffe Swing and Dual Bot station, or playground equipment in Burhanpur.

faq.q: Can playground equipment be used safely after dark?
faq.a: Yes, if the area is well lit and adults can see every piece. Our equipment does not include lighting, so plan it with your electrician and place the play area within the lit zone.

faq.q: Which colours are easiest to see in the evening?
faq.a: Lighter shades such as yellow, light blue and green stand out better at dusk than dark tones. We offer more than 15 roto-moulded colour shades to choose from.

faq.q: Do you deliver to Khandwa?
faq.a: Yes. We send equipment from our Vasai factory to Khandwa and the rest of Nimar by road, and install it through our own team or a dealer in Madhya Pradesh.

intro: Kharagpur is a railway town with one of the longest railway platforms in India, a large railway workshop and an IIT campus, with an air force station nearby. Its campuses and railway colonies have wide roads, cycle tracks and a lot of traffic moving between them. FunPlay Systems supplies playground equipment for these sites from our factory in Vasai, about 1,530 km away, and sends it to West Bengal by road.

On a campus or colony with constant cycle and scooter traffic, the boundary of the play area matters as much as the equipment inside it. Children leave a swing or slide at speed and rarely look before running. We plan the layout so that exits face away from roads and paths, with a hedge, fence or open lawn between the play area and moving traffic. The climate here is hot and humid, with a heavy monsoon, so drainage gets attention too.

sections.h: Keeping a play area clear of roads and cycle tracks
sections.html:
Set the play area back from the road, and put the gate on the side that faces a lawn or a quiet footpath. Point slide exits and swing arcs inward, towards the centre of the play area. A low hedge or fence along the road side stops a ball, or a child chasing one, from rolling into traffic. Keep cycle stands outside the boundary so bikes are never parked inside a safe play area.

See our Igloo Climber and our outdoor gym equipment in Kharagpur, or playground equipment in Haldia.

faq.q: How should a playground be placed near a road?
faq.a: Set back from the road, with the gate facing a quiet side and slide exits pointing inward. A hedge or fence along the road side keeps balls and children from running into traffic.

faq.q: Can campuses and railway colonies in Kharagpur order from you?
faq.a: Yes. Campuses, colonies, schools and housing complexes can order directly. We deliver from Vasai by road and install with our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

faq.q: Does Kharagpur's monsoon affect the play area?
faq.a: Heavy rain can pool on flat ground, so plan a slight slope and a drain before installation. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts handle the wet season without rusting.
